name: DCA Carthay Circle Famous Fried Cheddar, Bacon & Jalapeño Biscuits (Jalapeño Warning vs. Parker House Rolls!)
brandOrRestaurant: Carthay Circle Restaurant (Buena Vista Street · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: warm cheddar parker house rolls carthay
whyItWorks: Reference warning: Carthay's classic Fried Biscuits are stuffed with diced jalapeños and deep-fried—instead, order Carthay's **Warm Cheddar Parker House Rolls** (hold the chili butter), which are baked soft and jalapeño-free!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the jalapeño-stuffed Fried Biscuits and order the baked **Warm Cheddar Parker House Rolls** (with plain butter instead of calabrian chili-apricot butter).
watchOuts: Fried Biscuits contain diced jalapeño peppers and fryer oil
